metadata.title: ट्राइबल सब प्लान के पैसे को कैसे घुमाया | TSP Fund diverted in Karnataka
metadata.description: The Karnataka government's decision to reallocate funds from the Scheduled Caste Plan and Scheduled Tribe Sub Plan to finance its five guarantee schemes has sparked significant controversy. The BJP, the main opposition party, is preparing to challenge this decision in court. Meanwhile, senior state officials maintain that the reallocation is entirely legal and justified. For a deeper understanding, watch our comprehensive MBB explainer.
